customerName: Republic of Zambia (Ministry of Finance) / ZESCO Limited
overdueDescription: Semi-annual interest payment for July–December 2024 (2.85% p.a. on USD 150,000,000)
guarantorEntity: Republic of Zambia — Ministry of Finance
rootCause: ZESCO liquidity crisis: tariff under-recovery (38% below cost-recovery), drought-related hydropower generation shortfall reducing cash flows, and delayed GRZ fiscal transfer to ZESCO. Ministry of Finance has been notified and has acknowledged the arrears in writing.
resolutionPlan: Ministry of Finance to provide bridging ZESCO support via Q1 2025 fiscal allocation. Zambia Country Office has escalated to AfDB Treasury Department. ZESCO tariff reform discussions ongoing with ERB (Energy Regulation Board). Sovereign guarantee to be invoked if payment not received by March 31, 2025.
notes: Sovereign guarantee provides full credit protection. Account remains performing under IFRS 9 Stage 2 (significant increase in credit risk) pending payment clearance. Provision increased by USD 214,000 (10% specific provision on overdue amount).
